integrity: One theorem with direct Fourier local-limit proof, precise domain and explicit reproducible exact finite checker. No independent validation or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Loopless directed independent-arc probability one-half, four independent fair unary predicates, one fixed root and one specified depth-two counting-modal formula. General formulas, undirected models and biased/sparse cases are unproved; earlier equivalent results may exist.
title: A uniform mixed-Poisson law for two simultaneous counting balances on dense random digraphs
